This can create a positive feedback loop, where your confidence grows as others respond positively to you. It's also worth noting that the psychological benefits of dressing professionally can be just as important as the physical benefits. When you feel confident and put-together, you're more likely to take on challenges, speak up, and assert yourself in a positive way. So, it seems that your observation is spot on!
